changes.name: SkyCoinSystem100M
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local map=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap")
local folder=map:WaitForChild("SkyCoinPickups")
local busy={}

local function hook(coin)
 coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
  if not player or busy[coin] then return end
  local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
  local sky=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
  if not sky then return end
  busy[coin]=true
  sky.Value+=100000000
  coin.Transparency=1
  coin.CanTouch=false
  local light=coin:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
  if light then light.Enabled=false end
  task.delay(8,function()
   if coin.Parent then
    coin.Transparency=0
    coin.CanTouch=true
    if light then light.Enabled=true end
    busy[coin]=nil
   end
  end)
 end)
end

for _,coin in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
 if coin:IsA("BasePart") then hook(coin) end
end
